headline: LG Electronics Shares Fall 3% as Parent Plans 2% Stake Sale to Meet Shareholding Norms
summary: Shares of LG Electronics India dropped up to 3% after promoter LG Electronics Inc. announced plans to offload up to 2% of its holding via open-market transactions to comply with SEBI minimum public shareholding norms.
why: Secondary share sales by corporate promoters increase public float and can exert short-term downward price pressure due to sudden supply increases.

impacts.name: LG Electronics
impacts.why: Announcements of promoter share sales increase market supply and can cause immediate downward price adjustments.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The announcement of a promoter block sale to satisfy regulatory minimum public shareholding requirements created near-term supply pressure on the stock.
